title: VendPoint Restock, Consigned Stock and Cycle Count Settings
content:
Field service settings of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program, by machine model.

- **Scheduled restock visits per week.**
- **Low-stock trigger**: selection fill level, percent of par, at or below which the selection is restocked at the next visit.
- **Emergency restock fee**: fee per emergency restock visit requested by the customer, USD; **emergency response**: hours within which an emergency restock is made.
- **Consigned inventory**: whether machine stock stays Corbett-owned until vended; **machine stock cap**: largest consigned stock value loaded in the machine, USD.
- **Shrink billed to customer**: whether cycle count shortages beyond tolerance are billed to the customer (coil machines dispense one unit per vend and carry no customer shrink); **shrink tolerance**: cycle count shortage, percent of stock value counted, absorbed by Corbett; **shrink billing basis**: price at which billed shrink is valued; **cycle count frequency**: months between cycle counts of machine stock.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled restock visits per week | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 5 |
| Low-stock trigger, % of par | 30 | 30 | 25 | 25 | 20 | 20 |
| Emergency restock fee, USD | 75.00 | 75.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 45.00 | 0.00 |
| Emergency response, hours | 24 | 24 | 24 | 12 | 12 | 4 |
| Consigned inventory | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Machine stock cap, USD | 5000.00 | 9000.00 | 12000.00 | 18000.00 | 30000.00 | 120000.00 |
| Shrink billed to customer | yes | yes | no | no | no | yes |
| Shrink tolerance, % of stock value counted | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1.5 |
| Shrink billing basis | contract unit price | contract unit price | contract unit price | contract unit price | contract unit price | contract unit price |
| Cycle count frequency, months | 3 | 3 | 6 | 6 | 3 | 1 |

### Points of reading

- A low-stock trigger of 25 means a selection standing at or below 25% of its par is filled at the next visit; one standing above 25% is not triggered.
- Only the VendPoint Smart Crib 300 has a shrink tolerance above zero; every other model's tolerance is 0.
- The VendPoint Smart Crib 300 emergency restock fee is 0.00 USD.
